title: Cohomology of a projective bundle: for S a scheme, E a finite locally free O_S-module of constant rank n + 1 and pi : P(E) -> S, the higher direct images R^q pi_* O_{P(E)}(d) equal Sym^d(E) for q = 0, 0 for q not in {0, n}, and SheafHom(Sym^{-n-1-d}(E) tensor wedge^{n+1} E, O_S) for q = n; the identifications are compatible with base change and isomorphisms of locally free sheaves.

core_obligations: Build the exact Koszul complex on P(E) from the surjection pi^*E(-1) -> O_{P(E)}.
Run the first spectral sequence of pi_* on the acyclic complex; compute E_1 terms via the projection formula and the local projective-space cohomology.
Force the unique differential d_{n+1} to be an isomorphism to identify R^n pi_*O(-n-1) as the inverse of wedge^{n+1}E.
For d < -n-1 produce the perfect pairing with Sym^{-d-n-1}(E) tensor wedge^{n+1}(E), and record compatibilities with base change and isomorphisms.

proof_roadmap.step: Build the exact Koszul complex on P(E) from the surjection pi^*E(-1) -> O_{P(E)}.

difficulty_reason: The full argument sits in the span: the canonical surjection pi^*E(-1) -> O yields an exact Koszul complex (More on Algebra, homotopy-koszul-abstract); the first spectral sequence of Derived Categories (two-ss-complex-functor) applied to pi_* of this acyclic complex has E_1^{p,q} = wedge^{-p}E tensor R^q pi_*O(p) by the projection formula, vanishes off (0,0) and (-n-1,n) by local triviality of E and the projective-space computations (cohomology-projective-space-over-ring, identify-functorially, cohomology-projective-space-over-base), and the single differential d_{n+1} must be an isomorphism, identifying R^n pi_*O(-n-1) with (wedge^{n+1}E)^{-1}; the general d < -n-1 case is finished by exhibiting a perfect pairing via the map pi^*Sym^{-d-n-1}(E) tensor O(d) -> O(-n-1) and applying R^n pi_* with the projection formula.

dedup.scope: Higher direct images of twists of the structure sheaf of a projective bundle, proved via the Koszul complex and one spectral sequence.
